headline: RADISSON DRILLS TO 1,720m DEPTH AT O'BRIEN — 4.06 g/t AU OVER 13m, 178 g/t SPOT; 8 RIGS (TSXV:RDS)
snippet: Radisson Mining Resources (TSXV:RDS) released June 25 drill results extending high-grade gold at the O'Brien Gold Project, Abitibi, Quebec, to a new vertical depth of 1,720 metres — the deepest confirmation of the orogenic system to date — with standout hole OB-26-378W3 returning multiple zones including 4.06 g/t gold over 13.1m (incl. 23.79 g/t over 1.0m) and 8.43 g/t over 4.2m, while step-out OB-26-385W3 returned 178.69 g/t over 1.1m. Eight diamond drill rigs are currently active across a broad area as the company works to define the full extent of a multi-kilometre system.

headline: REVIVAL GOLD JOSS GROWS +240m DEEPER — 14.9 g/t AU OVER 5.9m AT 861m, 147m BULK AT 2.37 g/t (TSXV:RVG)
snippet: Revival Gold Inc. (TSXV:RVG) reported June 25 that its 2026 program at the Joss area of the Beartrack-Arnett Project in Idaho extended known high-grade gold mineralisation by 240 metres at depth — a 70% increase in vertical dimension to 850 metres — with drill hole BT26-254D intersecting 14.9 g/t gold over 5.9 metres at 861 metres downhole within a broader 147.2-metre interval grading 2.37 g/t gold. All five primary drill holes targeted the high-grade underground sulphide Panther Creek Shear Zone, and field work is wrapping up ahead of a resource update.

headline: ROCKLAND FINDS NEW VEIN BELOW RED LAKE HISTORIC WORKINGS — 16.89 g/t AU OVER 4m, 279 g/t PEAK (CSE:RKL)
snippet: Rockland Resources (CSE:RKL) announced June 25 assay results from its 2026 winter drill program at the Cole Gold Mines Property in Ontario's Red Lake Mining District, returning 16.89 g/t gold over 4.0 metres including 279.0 g/t over 0.5 metres — new veins confirmed below the historic 530 Foot Level at approximately 214m vertical depth, 53 metres below the deepest underground workings. Earlier holes in the same 19-hole program had already intersected 113 g/t over 0.5m, establishing a stacked sequence of quartz veins that significantly expands the known mineralised footprint.

headline: PRINCE SILVER HITS DEEPEST GOLD YET IN NEVADA — 2.41 g/t AU / 68.5 g/t AG OVER 15.24m; PROGRAM EXPANDING (CSE:PRNC)
source_name: Investing News Network / Prince Silver Corp. (CSE:PRNC)
snippet: Prince Silver Corp. (CSE:PRNC) released June 24 drill results from five additional holes in its 9,000-metre RC program at the Prince Silver Project in Nevada's Pioche Mining District, with hole PRC-44 intersecting 15.24 metres grading 2.41 g/t gold and 68.5 g/t silver from 259 metres — the company's strongest gold-bearing interval to date, extending a gold-rich sulphide zone at depth beneath the upper silver-manganese-lead-zinc oxide system. With assays in from 25 of 30 initial holes, management is adding at least 10 more holes and targeting a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate by year-end 2026.

headline: GOLDMINING TRADES AT CASH VALUE — US$185M ASSETS NEARLY EQUALS MARKET CAP; TWO PEAS SHOW $1.5B COMBINED NPV (TSX:GOLD)
snippet: GoldMining Inc. (TSX:GOLD, NASDAQ:GLDG) issued a June 26 mid-year update highlighting that its approximately US$185 million in cash and publicly traded securities nearly equals its entire market capitalisation — effectively offering the project portfolio at near-zero cost to investors — alongside delivery of two robust PEAs this year at São Jorge (NPV5% US$532 million) and La Mina (NPV5% US$1.0 billion), with active drilling underway at the Yarumalito gold-copper project in Colombia against a 13.1-million-ounce AuEq M+I global resource base of 22.1M oz total.

headline: NICOLA MINING JOTUN PORPHYRY CONFIRMED — 840m HOLE HITS VISIBLE NATIVE COPPER, STRONGEST ALTERATION EVER AT CRAIGMONT (TSXV:NIM)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Nicola Mining Inc. (TSXV:NIM)
snippet: Nicola Mining Inc. (TSXV:NIM, NASDAQ:NICM) announced June 26 completion of the inaugural drill hole JT-26-001 at the Jotun target within its wholly owned New Craigmont Copper Project near Merritt, British Columbia, confirming the geological hallmarks of a new porphyry copper system: the strongest quartz-K feldspar vein networks and most intensive porphyry-style alteration drilled anywhere on the property filled the top 186 metres, with occurrences of visible native copper validating the geophysical and geochemical anomalies that originally defined the target. Assay results are pending — this is the first new porphyry centre identified at New Craigmont in the current exploration cycle.

headline: POWER METALLIC'S LION ZONE LAST INFILL HITS 8.45% CUEQ OVER 5.26m — JULY MRE + PEA QUEUED UP (TSXV:PNPN)
snippet: Power Metallic Mines Inc. (TSXV:PNPN) reported June 23 the final infill results from its Winter 2026 program at the Lion Zone in Quebec: hole PML-26-115 returned 13.30 metres at 3.98% copper equivalent from 25m (including 3.8m at 9.36% CuEq), and hole PML-26-105 returned 5.26 metres at 8.45% CuEq from approximately 140m — high-grade copper-PGE-nickel-silver mineralisation targeted for open-pit resource definition. These are among the final assays feeding into an initial NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate for Lion scheduled for end of July, followed immediately by a Preliminary Economic Assessment.

headline: PIRATE GOLD STEPS OUT AT MOBY DICK — CHALCOPYRITE IN TWO MORE HOLES EXPANDS COPPER-GOLD DISCOVERY (TSXV:YARR)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV:YARR)
snippet: Pirate Gold Corp. (TSXV:YARR) announced June 25 that step-out drill holes PGC-26-118 and PGC-26-120 at the Moby Dick copper-gold discovery on its Treasure Island Project have returned broad zones of visible chalcopyrite — the primary copper sulphide mineral — confirming the footprint of the discovery extends beyond the initial intercepts. Assay results are pending; these are the first step-out holes drilled beyond the original discovery zone, representing a potential size expansion for the most significant copper-gold discovery on the project to date.

headline: TSXV BASE METALS LEAD GOLD INTO SUMMER — TUNGSTEN 4X, NORTHISLE +268%, MACTUNG FEASIBILITY STUDY UNDERWAY
snippet: While gold corrected toward 2026 lows near $4,000, a wave of TSXV copper, zinc, and tungsten developers surged on structural critical-minerals tailwinds: Northisle Copper and Gold (NCX) is up 268% over 12 months, Fireweed Metals (FWZ) gained 101%, and Blue Moon Zinc advanced 217%, each well ahead of the TSXV Mining Index's 89% gain. Tungsten is the standout at roughly 4x since December 2025 — China controls 78.8% of global supply and its ongoing export controls are driving Western buyers toward Fireweed's MacTung deposit in the Yukon, the world's largest high-grade tungsten resource, now advancing toward a Feasibility Study with a US$15.8 million Department of Defense backing.

headline: STIFEL: GOLD BEATS S&P 500 BY 1.9% IN SUMMER, SILVER BY 4% — 25 YEARS OF DATA SAY BUY WINDOW IS OPEN NOW
snippet: GoldSeek's weekly Gold SWOT analysis, citing Stifel research across 25 years of historical data, finds that gold and silver have outperformed the S&P 500 through the summer months by an average of 1.9% and 4%, respectively — a consistent seasonal pattern that argues the current June correction, with positioning fully reset and central bank buying at record pace, opens one of the calendar's most statistically reliable re-entry windows for precious metals investors. The analysis notes that seasonal strength typically begins to materialise in July, with autumn acceleration following, making the next two to three weeks the critical accumulation period for both the metals and the mining equities that amplify their moves.
